usages.usage: make + 人 + 形容詞表示使某人有某種感覺或狀態
the day is mine 表示這一天完全由我支配

breakdowns.sentence: Hello and welcome back to my slow English podcast, a podcast for you to practice listening to slow English and learn English while listening to fun stories about my life.
breakdowns.translation: 這是一個讓你練習聽慢速英文、並學英文的 Podcast。

points.label: 名詞同位語加 for + object + to V
points.text: a podcast + for you + to practice / learn
points.note: a podcast 後面再用同位語補充說明這個 podcast 的用途；for you to V 表示為了讓你做某事。

breakdowns.sentence: I love how full of vegetation Oaxaca is.
breakdowns.translation: 我很喜歡瓦哈卡有這麼豐富的植物。

points.label: how 引導的名詞子句
points.text: love + how + adjective phrase + subject + be
points.note: how 後面接一個完整子句，用來表達某件事的程度或樣子。

breakdowns.sentence: Walking through the vibrant streets in Oaxaca, getting to see all of the street art and murals, and all of the insanely hard work the artists put into these murals was very impressive.
breakdowns.translation: 走在瓦哈卡的街道上並看到那些藝術作品，讓人印象非常深刻。

points.label: 動名詞片語當主詞
points.text: Walking through ..., getting to see ... + was + adjective
points.note: 用 V-ing 片語當整個句子的主詞，描述一整個經驗，後面用單數動詞 was。

breakdowns.sentence: That had to be the best croissant I have ever tried.
breakdowns.translation: 那一定是我吃過最好吃的可頌。

points.label: had to be 表推論加最高級現在完成式
points.text: had to be + the best + noun + I have ever + past participle
points.note: had to be 在這裡不是被迫，而是表示說話者很肯定的推論；I have ever tried 用現在完成式表示到目前為止吃過的經驗。

breakdowns.sentence: It was such a delight to swim in the ocean again.
breakdowns.translation: 能再次在海裡游泳真是一件令人開心的事。

points.label: It is such a noun to V
points.text: It + be + such a + noun + to V
points.note: 先用 it 當形式主詞，真正的重點是後面的 to swim in the ocean again。

breakdowns.sentence: It was unbelievable that we were able to stay in such a nice room.
breakdowns.translation: 我們能住在這麼好的房間，真是難以置信。

points.label: It is adjective that 子句
points.text: It + be + adjective + that + subject + verb
points.note: 用 it 當形式主詞，that 子句說明真正令人覺得 unbelievable 的內容。

breakdowns.sentence: All around the city, there were so many flowers hanging from trees, on bushes, just everywhere.
breakdowns.translation: 到處都有好多花掛在樹上。

points.label: 現在分詞片語修飾名詞
points.note: hanging from trees 用來補充說明 flowers 的狀態，相當於 flowers that were hanging from trees。

breakdowns.sentence: We headed to the place we were going to rent for one month.
breakdowns.translation: 我們前往我們要租一個月的地方。

points.label: 省略關係代名詞加過去中的未來
points.text: the place + subject + were going to + verb
points.note: the place 後面省略了 that；were going to rent 表示從當時看來接下來要租的地方。

breakdowns.sentence: It was so nice to have starfruit whenever we wanted.
breakdowns.translation: 想吃楊桃時就能吃到，真的很好。

points.label: whenever 引導時間副詞子句
points.note: whenever 表示每當任何時候，比 when 更強調任何一次都可以。

breakdowns.sentence: Once I'm done checking some emails and finishing little things on my computer, I head upstairs again.
breakdowns.translation: 等我查看完一些郵件，也完成電腦上的一些小事後，我又上樓。

points.label: Once 引導時間副詞子句
points.text: Once + subject + be done + V-ing, subject + verb
points.note: once 表示一旦、當……之後；be done V-ing 表示完成某件事。

breakdowns.sentence: Every day in Puerto Escondido, I would go to the beach.
breakdowns.translation: 在埃斯孔迪多港的每一天，我都會去海灘。

points.label: would 表過去習慣
points.note: would 在這裡不是條件句，而是描述過去某段時間裡常常做的事。

breakdowns.sentence: No matter if I was tired or angry or too busy, I would always find time to walk to the beach.
breakdowns.translation: 無論我是累了、生氣了，還是太忙了，我總會找時間走去海灘。

points.label: 讓步副詞子句
points.text: No matter if + clause, main clause
points.note: No matter if 表示不論前面的情況是否發生，後面的主句結果都一樣。

breakdowns.sentence: Then we get on our bike and head to a new beach I had never visited.
breakdowns.translation: 然後我們騎上車，前往一個我以前從沒去過的新海灘。

points.label: 關係子句加過去完成式
points.text: a new beach + that + subject + had never been to
points.note: that 引導關係子句修飾 beach；had never been to 表示在當時去那個海灘以前，從來沒有去過。

breakdowns.sentence: I look at some cookies for when I'm craving something sweet.
breakdowns.translation: 我會看一些餅乾，留給自己想吃甜食的時候。

points.label: for when 子句
points.note: for when 表示為了某個將來可能出現的時候或情境而準備。

breakdowns.sentence: So, if you're interested, check out the link in the description and join the Slow English Club.
breakdowns.translation: 如果你有興趣，請查看說明欄裡的連結，並加入 Slow English Club。

points.label: if 條件子句加祈使句
points.text: If + subject + be + adjective, imperative verb
points.note: if 子句提出條件，後面的 check out 和 join 是祈使句，用來提出建議或邀請。
